_data_sources_needed: DBIR web-app pattern by industry (sector shares)
IRIS Exploit Public-Facing Application by revenue (base-rate anchor)
_metadata._susceptibility_note: Edgescan (web app/API = 31.9% of critical+high findings, 2026) and Cobalt (serious-finding prevalence by sector, 2025) measure vulnerability prevalence: whether an attempt would succeed. They belong to the susceptibility assessment, not TEF; using them for TEF multipliers would count exposure twice.

base_rate_triangulation.consensus_note: Exploitation-dominant scenario. DBIR 2026 exploitation = 31% of initial access. Mode anchored at ~1.5x exfiltration consensus mode (exploitation is the most common vector).

vector_proportions._citation: DBIR 2026 Web Application pattern, adjusted for exploitation dominance

web_app_overall_share._citation: DBIR 2026 incident classification pattern Basic Web Application Attacks = 10% of breaches (n=22,625 breaches, 2024-2025 data; Substrata record dbir2026_basic_web_app_all_all, hand-verified from PDF). Caveat: DBIR's denominator is breaches, while overall_share is used as a share of all cyber incidents (IRIS basis for ransomware), so the scale is approximate.

web_app_sector_shares._citation: Derived from sector_multipliers x overall_share. Technology skew from higher web surface area.

web_app_revenue_shares._citation: No web-app-specific revenue breakdown available. Uses all-incident shares from IRIS 2025.

web_app_revenue_prob_gte2._citation: Not available from IRIS for web-app specifically. All null — tool falls back to overall floor.

sector_multipliers._citation: IRIS 2025 + Cofense 2026 bypass rates, adjusted for web-app exposure (technology 1.8x reflects higher web surface)

credential_tempo._citation: Web-app credential attacks (credential stuffing, brute force). Lower campaign volume than ransomware — attacks are more targeted to specific web applications.

exploitation_scanning._citation: GreyNoise-derived. Web-app exploitation uses a HIGH share of scanning activity — this is the primary vector.
exploitation_scanning.grn_malicious_rate_note: Higher than ransomware baseline — web-app is exploitation-dominant.
exploitation_scanning.poa_ransomware_note: Higher PoA than other scenarios — exploitation is the primary success path.
exploitation_scanning.ransomware_proportion_note: Web-app exploitation constitutes a large share of vulnerability scanning.

output_templates.one_sentence: Based on industry data, threat actors {attempt_verb} organizations matching your profile roughly once every {recurrence_years:.0f} years (range: {low_yr:.0f}-{high_yr:.0f} years). This measures how often adversaries TRY -- not how often they succeed. Success probability depends on your controls (assessed separately).
